verdict.rationale: The evidence shows JumpCloud enforcing SSO across SAML and OIDC-based apps, which is generic protocol support. Nothing in the pack documents a pre-built app integration catalog, its size, or connection in minutes, so this is an adjacent capability rather than the story itself.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the SSO catalog covers my stack — thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations that connect in minutes, not custom projects
